{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient
deduplicated_data = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Now filter for control arm and moderate severity
treatment_group = deduplicated_data[(deduplicated_data['arm'] == 'control') & (deduplicated_data['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Compute the fraction who responded
n_total = len(treatment_group)
n_responded = treatment_group['responded'].sum()
fraction_responded = n_responded / n_total

# Print the numbers
print(f"Number of control-arm, moderate-severity patients after deduplication: {n_total}")
print(f"Number who responded: {n_responded}")
print(f"Fraction responded: {fraction_responded}")"}
